description: Reasoning toolkit of 57 skills — decomposition, questioning, assumption excavation, perspective shifts, decision analysis, ideation, synthesis, and epistemic integrity checks. Installed skills invoke as /thinkies:<name>.
name: thinkies

records_mirror.description: Optional folder that receives a copy of every thinkies record. The plugin's data folder is deleted on uninstall unless you pass --keep-data; the mirror is not.
records_mirror.title: Records mirror folder
